caption: The drawing features a single metal tool placed on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or textures. The object appears to be a metallic scoop or ladle with a narrow, rectangular scoop portion that curves up at one end, forming a partial spiral curl. The surface of the scoop is depicted in shades of brown, grey, and hints of green, with some areas showing a patina or worn texture. The handle is straight and tapers slightly, with a rectangular slot near the end. The handle and scoop are joined at a slight angle, and the entire object casts no visible shadow. The artist's name, "Oscar Bluemner," is inscribed in small letters at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Pump Stock Reamer
